# Asteroid Dodge

- **Core mechanic:** Player moves a ship left/right at the bottom of the canvas and shoots or dodges falling asteroids.
- **Goal:** Destroy as many asteroids as possible.
- **Lose condition:** An asteroid collides with the ship or reaches the bottom of the canvas.

1: // Simple Asteroid Dodge game
2: // Canvas with id="game" must exist in the page
3: 
4: (function () {
5:   const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
6:   if (!canvas) return console.error('Canvas #game not found');
7:   const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
8: 
9:   // Audio setup using Web Audio API
10:   const audioCtx = new (window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext)();
11:   // Resume audio on first user interaction (required by browsers)
12:   const resumeAudio = () => { audioCtx.resume(); window.removeEventListener('click', resumeAudio); };
13:   window.addEventListener('click', resumeAudio);
14: 
15:   const audioCtx = new (window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext)();
16:   function beep(freq, duration) {
17:     const osc = audioCtx.createOscillator();
18:     const gain = audioCtx.createGain();
19:     osc.frequency.value = freq;
20:     osc.type = 'sine';
21:     osc.connect(gain);
22:     gain.connect(audioCtx.destination);
23:     gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.1, audioCtx.currentTime);
24:     osc.start();
25:     osc.stop(audioCtx.currentTime + duration);
26:   }
27:   const playShoot = () => beep(800, 0.05);
28:   const playExplosion = () => beep(200, 0.2);
29:   const playGameOver = () => beep(100, 0.5);
30: 
31:   // Set canvas size (fallback if not set in HTML)
32:   canvas.width = canvas.width || 400;
33:   canvas.height = canvas.height || 600;
34: 
35:   // Starfield configuration
36:   const starCount = Math.floor(canvas.width * canvas.height / 8000);
37:   const stars = [];
38:   for (let i = 0; i < starCount; i++) {
39:     stars.push({
40:       x: Math.random() * canvas.width,
41:       y: Math.random() * canvas.height,
42:       size: Math.random() * 2 + 1,
43:       speed: Math.random() * 0.5 + 0.2,
44:     });
45:   }
46: 
47:   // Ship configuration
48:   const ship = {
49:     width: 40,
50:     height: 20,
51:     x: canvas.width / 2 - 20,
52:     y: canvas.height - 30,
53:     speed: 5,
54:     color: '#0ff',
55:   };
56: 
57:   // Input handling
58:   const keys = {};
59:   window.addEventListener('keydown', e => (keys[e.key] = true));
60:   window.addEventListener('keyup', e => (keys[e.key] = false));
61: 
62:   // Asteroid pool
63:   const asteroids = [];
64:   const asteroidSpawnInterval = 1000; // ms
65:   let lastAsteroidTime = 0;
66: 
67:   // Bullet pool (optional shooting)
68:   const bullets = [];
69:   const bulletSpeed = 7;
70: 
71:   function spawnAsteroid() {
72:     const size = Math.random() * 30 + 10;
73:     asteroids.push({
74:       x: Math.random() * (canvas.width - size),
75:       y: -size,
76:       size,
77:       speed: Math.random() * 2 + 1,
78:     });
79:   }
80: 
81:   function update(dt) {
82:   // Move starfield
83:   stars.forEach(s => {
84:     s.y += s.speed;
85:     if (s.y > canvas.height) {
86:       s.y = 0;
87:       s.x = Math.random() * canvas.width;
88:     }
89:   });
90:     // Move ship
91:     if (keys['ArrowLeft']) ship.x -= ship.speed;
92:     if (keys['ArrowRight']) ship.x += ship.speed;
93:     // Keep within bounds
94:     ship.x = Math.max(0, Math.min(canvas.width - ship.width, ship.x));
95: 
96:     // Shoot with space
97:     if (keys[' '] && bullets.length < 5) {
98:       bullets.push({ x: ship.x + ship.width / 2, y: ship.y });
99:       playShoot();
100:     }
101: 
102:     // Update bullets
103:     for (let i = bullets.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
104:       const b = bullets[i];
105:       b.y -= bulletSpeed;
106:       if (b.y < 0) bullets.splice(i, 1);
107:     }
108: 
109:     // Spawn asteroids
110:     if (Date.now() - lastAsteroidTime > asteroidSpawnInterval) {
111:       spawnAsteroid();
112:       lastAsteroidTime = Date.now();
113:     }
114: 
115:     // Update asteroids
116:     for (let i = asteroids.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
117:       const a = asteroids[i];
118:       a.y += a.speed;
119:       // Remove if off screen
120:       if (a.y > canvas.height) {
121:         asteroids.splice(i, 1);
122:         continue;
123:       }
124:       // Collision with ship (lose condition)
125:       if (
126:         a.x < ship.x + ship.width &&
127:         a.x + a.size > ship.x &&
128:         a.y < ship.y + ship.height &&
129:         a.y + a.size > ship.y
130:       ) {
131:         // Game over: stop loop
132:         cancelAnimationFrame(animId);
133:         ctx.fillStyle = 'red';
134:         ctx.font = '30px sans-serif';
135:         ctx.fillText('Game Over', canvas.width / 2 - 80, canvas.height / 2);
136:         return;
137:       }
138:       // Collision with bullets (destroy asteroid)
139:       for (let j = bullets.length - 1; j >= 0; j--) {
140:         const b = bullets[j];
141:         if (
142:           b.x > a.x &&
143:           b.x < a.x + a.size &&
144:           b.y > a.y &&
145:           b.y < a.y + a.size
146:         ) {
147:           playExplosion();
148:           asteroids.splice(i, 1);
149:           bullets.splice(j, 1);
150:           break;
151:         }
152:       }
153:     }
154:   }
155: 
156: function draw() {
157:     // Dark background
158:     ctx.fillStyle = '#000';
159:     ctx.fillRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
160: 
161:     // Draw starfield
162:     ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
163:     stars.forEach(s => ctx.fillRect(s.x, s.y, s.size, s.size));
164: 
165:     // Draw ship as triangle
166:     ctx.fillStyle = ship.color;
167:     ctx.beginPath();
168:     ctx.moveTo(ship.x, ship.y + ship.height);
169:     ctx.lineTo(ship.x + ship.width / 2, ship.y);
170:     ctx.lineTo(ship.x + ship.width, ship.y + ship.height);
171:     ctx.closePath();
172:     ctx.fill();
173: 
174:     // Draw asteroids with radial gradient
175:     asteroids.forEach(a => {
176:       const grad = ctx.createRadialGradient(
177:         a.x + a.size / 2,
178:         a.y + a.size / 2,
179:         a.size * 0.1,
180:         a.x + a.size / 2,
181:         a.y + a.size / 2,
182:         a.size / 2
183:       );
184:       grad.addColorStop(0, '#bbb');
185:       grad.addColorStop(1, '#555');
186:       ctx.fillStyle = grad;
187:       ctx.beginPath();
188:       ctx.arc(a.x + a.size / 2, a.y + a.size / 2, a.size / 2, 0, Math.PI * 2);
189:       ctx.fill();
190:     });
191: 
192:     // Draw bullets as small cyan rectangles
193:     ctx.fillStyle = '#0ff';
194:     bullets.forEach(b => ctx.fillRect(b.x - 1, b.y - 4, 2, 8));
195:   }
196: 
197:   let lastTime = 0;
198:   let animId;
199:   function loop(timestamp) {
200:     const dt = timestamp - lastTime;
201:     lastTime = timestamp;
202:     update(dt);
203:     draw();
204:     animId = requestAnimationFrame(loop);
205:   }
206:   requestAnimationFrame(loop);
207: })();

(End of file - total 207 lines)
</content>
